newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romanian leu 3,769 to dollar for Dec 17-BNR.
newsitem.headline: Romanian leu 3,769 to dollar for Dec 17-BNR.

text.p: Romania's National Bank (BNR) announced the leu's reference rate at 3,769 to the dollar for December 17.
This reference rate was set on Friday as a weighted average based on daily reports of foreign exchange operators. It is a guidance rate used for statistical accounting purposes.
The leu's reference rate set on Thursday for December 16 is 3,768 to the dollar. It is 3,732 for December 13 to 15. -- Bucharest Newsroom 40-1 3120264
